basics.name: Matthew Strasiotto
basics.label: Software Engineer
basics.summary: Full-stack software engineer with around four years of experience across IoT platforms, business software and application security. Works across product discovery, frontend and backend development, and AWS infrastructure, primarily using React, TypeScript, Kotlin/Spring Boot and PostgreSQL.

work.summary: Full-stack development of IoT management and business operations platforms, spanning frontend and backend engineering, cloud infrastructure, and product discovery using PostHog.
highlights: Built bulk-management capabilities for thousands of IoT devices at a time, covering device settings, alerts and sensor-reporting rules.
Cut database time for a bulk device-settings lookup from 13 seconds to about 120 milliseconds.
Developed end-to-end workflows for emergency-light testing and compliance reporting.
Diagnosed faults across an IoT platform serving tens of thousands of devices using Splunk log analysis and PostHog.
Automated AWS resource provisioning for development environments across two applications using OpenTofu.

work.summary: Full-stack product engineering and a Snyk Code engagement spanning static-analysis rules, developer tooling and application security.
highlights: Built product features with React, TypeScript, GraphQL, NoSQL and PostgreSQL.
Shipped self-serve data/API: OpenAPI spec, secure endpoints, embedded API docs.
Implemented CI doc-gen for Cube.js data models; docs-as-code keeps docs aligned with code.
Built React + Apollo GraphQL features; strengthened typed UI→Graph contracts.
Closed the loop with customers to prioritise onboarding and activation improvements.
Developed and deployed kubernetes IaC stack to variety of environments including AWS + bare-metal
Developed and reviewed static-analysis rules for Snyk Code across multiple languages and frameworks.
Investigated customer-reported findings and improved security modelling, reproduction guidance and developer documentation.
Built framework-documentation and coverage-reporting tooling.

projects.name: matthewstrasiotto/mandrake
projects.summary: `R` package that connects `code` `</>` docs to `data` docs 📈 [demo](https://straz.to/mandrake/articles/mandrake.html#graph)
highlights: Extends standard docstring tools to accomodate structured documentation of fields of input & output data
Structured data doc can be serialized, & used in enriching directional acyclic graphs (DAGs) of pipeline

Information about a given target (eg, command used to generate, links to functions used, documentation on target properties) in a pipeline can be discovered by clicking on that target in the network graph.
